backfill_news.headline: Grant County Landfill Tipping Fee and Allowance Changes Approved for September 2026
backfill_news.summary: Grant County commissioners approved changes to landfill operations effective September 1, 2026, including a reduction in monthly allowance from one ton to 500 pounds and increases to tipping fees. Final fee amounts were to be determined in subsequent meetings.
